decisions.reason: The white-label test vinyl series builds on the firm's existing vinyl and collector business at low incremental cost, and growing industry turnover gives no signal of a shortfall against aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search, although limited-run test pressings carry some risk of quietly ending.

The German new wave compilation series sits close to the in-house label's core catalog model, and with sector growth and no reported difficulties its results likely meet aspirations, so management has no reason to withdraw it.
